test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Technology has made it possible for us to reach out to more students, and it has also made it possible for us to deliver the same lessons in a much more __________ manner.
solution:
The correct answer is '**resourceful**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**resourceful**" means having the ability to find quick and clever ways to overcome difficulties. (संसाधनपूर्ण)
 
• Technology enables the delivery of lessons in a more efficient and resourceful manner.
 
• The other options: "**incompetent**," "**lumbering**," and "**encumbering**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Technology has made it possible for us to reach out to more students, and it has also made it possible for us to deliver the same lessons in a much more resourceful__ manner.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Incompetent (अयोग्य)**: means not having the necessary skills or ability.
 
• **Lumbering (धीरे-धीरे चलना)**: means moving in a slow, heavy, awkward way.
 
• **Encumbering (बाधा डालना)**: means restricting or burdening in such a way that movement is difficult.
